traits.perianth.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010) p. 257: Salix and Populus are the extreme of the family's floral reduction, their flowers in catkins with no perianth (nectar glands in its place in Salix).

traits.epicormic.note: Meier, Saunders and Michler (2012, read in full) place willows among trees whose epicormic buds are single and whose first meristems lie buried in the bark for decades (Salix alba), sprouting when released.
